title: ci: install lz4 instead of liblz4-tool
body:
`ubuntu-latest` now resolves to Ubuntu 26.04 (resolute). On it, `liblz4-tool` has no installation candidate, so the `Install packages (Ubuntu)` step fails and every Ubuntu job in CI fails within seconds. One example, from #3564: https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/actions/runs/39399709616

The log says:

    E: Package 'liblz4-tool' has no installation candidate

The tests only need the `lz4` command (see `compressed_lz4` in `tests/misc.rs`), and the `lz4` package provides it, so this changes the package name.

I haven't tested this anywhere except through this PR's own CI run. If another package in that list is also missing on 26.04, apt will stop at that one next.
